title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.65: Text/localization pass. Rewrote the Orobas True Mask dialogue (now a simple gift exchange) and polished the Tanx conducting line, plus a mod-wide cleanup - fixed typos/title-case/grammar, standardized keyword tagging (Vigor/Block/simultaneously, lowercase 'invertible', un-tagged card types), 'attacks and skills'/'in your hand' phrasing, and em-dashes. No gameplay changes.
